title: GTA 6 Ultimate Edition Sticker Mocks Buyers? (Reported)
sources: mein-mmo: GTA 6 fans discover a secret message in the expensive edition (sticker in promo screenshot)
OpenCritic news 33881: GTA 6 Screenshot Mocks Ultimate Edition Buyers, Fans Believe
GamesRadar: exclusive single-player shops and side missions locked to the $100 Ultimate Edition (reported); Rockstar has not confirmed any intent

lines.text: Did Rockstar hide an insult for fans who paid a hundred dollars?
Fans found a sticker in a promo screenshot of the GTA 6 Ultimate Edition.
It reportedly says: buy more useless stuff. Only ruder.
The Ultimate Edition costs ninety nine ninety nine. Standard costs seventy nine ninety nine.
And some single player shops and side missions are reportedly locked behind it.
So some fans are furious, and call the sticker a wink at the buyers.
But some outlets say it may just be decoration, and nobody confirmed it was on purpose.
So is it a secret jab, or just a sticker? Comment A for jab, B for sticker.
